I am an old woman, and my hands have worked this small maize plot for many years. I have no schooling, so I do what my mother did and what my neighbors do — I put the manure from my few animals on the plot because it is free, and I save my own seed from last year's harvest like always. Fertilizer from the cooperative is dear, and for such a small piece of land I cannot spare the cash this season, so I will put only a little — maybe share part of a bag with my daughter-in-law's plot. My son helps me plough with the oxen, and I weed with my own hands; I do not have money to pay anyone.
